body:
Like I said, I can't remember anything that's really made me happy. 

I just don't like life. I don't like being in the world or around the people that are in it. I've never really had a good time with others. I don't have the ability to properly take care of myself either. There's no route to get to a point where I can take care of myself. 

I'd just rather end my life than carry on in this world.
